title: feat: right-side visual editor drawer with real-time preview
body:
Edit buttons on PageView and DashboardView previously navigated to separate `/design/` routes, breaking context and preventing live preview. This PR replaces that navigation with an inline right-side drawer (Shadcn Sheet) that keeps the main view visible and syncs editor changes to the renderer in real-time. ### Changes - **`DesignDrawer` component** — Reusable right-side Sheet panel using render props pattern. Handles auto-save on every change, Ctrl+S/Cmd+S explicit save with toast, and sr-only description for a11y. - **`PageView` / `DashboardView`** — Edit button now toggles drawer open instead of `navigate()`. Local `editSchema` state is lifted so both the renderer and the editor share the same schema reference — changes propagate instantly. - **Editors lazy-loaded** inside the drawer via `React.lazy()` to avoid increasing the initial bundle. - **Backward compatible** — existing `/design/page/:pageName` and `/design/dashboard/:dashboardName` routes remain intact. - **7 new tests** covering drawer lifecycle, real-time preview sync, auto-save, Ctrl+S, and no-navigation assertion. - **ROADMAP.md** updated to reflect completion. ### How it works ```tsx // PageView: edit button opens drawer, schema changes flow to SchemaRenderer const [editSchema, setEditSchema] = useState(null); const previewSchema = drawerOpen && editSchema ? editSchema : page; {(schema, onChange) => } ``` All 50 console test files pass (615 tests). CodeQL: 0 alerts.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 可视化编辑面板从右侧展开并支持修改后实时预览 > ## 功能描述 > 可视化编辑的面板应从页面右侧以抽屉（Drawer）方式展开。用户通过该面板进行编辑时，所做的修改应能立即在主页面或相关组件中预览效果，无需额外保存或刷新操作。 > > ## 需求细节 > - 编辑面板以右侧抽屉形式出现，不覆盖主工作区内容； > - 用户在编辑面板中修改配置或样式时，预览区实时反映所做更改。 > - 支持多种类型的可视化内容（如仪表盘、表格、图表等）的编辑实时同步预览； > - 面板关闭时保留或还原用户编辑前的状态（可根据用户需求选择） > - 实现良好的交互体验，例如动画、拖拽等。 > - 确保新面板功能配合原有 UI，无突兀切换。 > > ## 设计参考 > > > ## 验收标准 > - 右侧编辑面板交互顺畅、无明显卡顿 > - 编辑内容能被即时预览 > - UI 整体风格与系统一致 > - 部署后运行相关 test 确保功能无异常 > - 跟进相关问题并及时更新 roadmap > > > 完成功能开发后，需运行测试，并根据实际情况更新 roadmap。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
